entries.title: Psalms 98:1
segments: The people of God praise him for his victory over sin and death, while they embrace and rejoice in his salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 98:2
segments: Made known his salvation: his righteousness; manifested his righteousness in the salvation of his people.  These words are fulfilled in every interposition of God for his people, especially in the mission of his Son.

entries.title: Psalms 98:3
segments:
Remembered his mercy and his truth; in the fulfilment of his promises. 
 
The places most distant from Judea, including the remotest heathen nations, shall one day hear of and experience the salvation of God.

entries.title: Psalms 98:9
segments: The coming of God to judge the world by Jesus Chrsit, is an event to which the righteous look forward with unspeakable joy.
